prompt: The greeting shortcode only works when the URL has ?name=. Add a settings field (for example under Settings > General) where an admin can set a default greeting name, and use it whenever the name query parameter is missing.
expected_output: An admin-only settings field stores a default greeting name under a plugin-prefixed option, protected by a capability check or the Settings API's own nonce; the shortcode falls back to that option and escapes the name it renders instead of echoing the raw request value.

expectations.text: The greeting name is no longer echoed without escaping
The new settings field is protected by a capability check or a nonce
The new setting is stored under a plugin-prefixed option key
The greeting shortcode is still registered
Nothing new at the repository root
